program: Proposed intensive youth mentorship and crisis-response year

judgments.label: Annual intensive-place allowance
judgments.basis: $10,000 planning assumption, loosely calibrated to secondary launch reporting of $200,000 for up to 20 intended youth. Not an audited marginal quote or evidence that all contacts receive a year of intensive support. Joint TLCBD/UP allocation and startup costs unknown.

judgments.label: Counterfactual annual fatal-violence risk
judgments.basis: 0.5% assumed risk for the effectively engaged high-risk subgroup, not all SF youth or observed local program participants. This is fatal violence, not pooled shootings or arrests.

judgments.label: Relative fatal-risk reduction among effectively engaged
judgments.basis: 10% subjective causal reduction conditional on effective engagement. Not READI's intention-to-treat coefficient: that already includes uptake. Negative values represent increased risk.

judgments.label: Effective engagement share
judgments.basis: 75% assumed share of offered places reaching the modeled dose. Apply once because effect is conditional-on-engagement, not ITT.

judgments.label: Funding additionality
judgments.basis: 50% judgment after replacement funding and services otherwise available. Do not apply a second program-uptake discount here.

judgments.label: Lifetime QALYs per death averted
judgments.basis: 20 already-discounted, health-adjusted QALYs is an explicit analyst assumption, not a local survival estimate. No extra year multiplier or separate life-saved bonus.

nullBoundary: Positive scenarios are judgments, not a confidence interval. Null or harmful program effects remain possible; negative conditional risk reduction produces signed negative QALYs and no positive-benefit price. The reference trial does not establish a local mortality effect.
threshold: At $10,000/place and 20 QALYs per death, under $100,000/10 QALYs requires more than 0.05 net deaths prevented per place-year. That exceeds the central assumed 0.005 baseline risk even before partial effect or funding replacement.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: Primary restricted budget, intensive caseload/dose, participant risk profile, current additional places, TLCBD/UP fiscal allocation and outcome comparison.

excluded: Gun-buyback counts converted to prevented deaths
Shooting arrests or combined nonfatal/fatal events treated as deaths
Education, earnings, incarceration savings or unmeasured neighborhood spillovers
Repeated duration or uptake multipliers applied to an ITT coefficient
